gloss: each time; every time; on each occasion

definitions.gloss: each time; every time; on each occasion
definitions.explanation: Every time a particular situation occurs, the action is performed anew. Emphasizes repeated action in response to recurring events.

examples.japanese: その{都度|つど}{対応|たいおう}する。
examples.english: I deal with it each time.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}が{起|お}きたらその{都度|つど}{報告|ほうこく}してください。
examples.english: Please report every time a problem occurs.

examples.japanese: まとめて{買|か}うより、{必要|ひつよう}なものをその{都度|つど}{買|か}うほうが{無駄|むだ}がない。
examples.english: Rather than buying in bulk, it's less wasteful to buy what you need each time.

notes:
USAGE:
A versatile expression used in both formal and informal contexts. {都度|つど} means "each time" and is bound with その (that) to form this adverbial phrase. Can also appear without その in more formal writing: {都度|つど}{確認|かくにん}する (to confirm each time).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- その{都度|つど}{対応|たいおう}する (to handle each time)
- その{都度|つど}{確認|かくにん}する (to check each time)
- その{都度|つど}{報告|ほうこく}する (to report each time)
- その{都度|つど}{払|はら}い (pay-as-you-go)
